messages:
maya: Quick sync — mapping dependencies for the Optimize toolkit MVP. We need a clear prioritization that ties customer tiers -> infra work (batching/caching) -> quant pipelines -> eval-alert hooks. Who's got cycles to help draft a dependency matrix today?

sam: I can help. Do we want to treat Dedicated customers differently for rollout?

jordan: Yes — proposed split: Tier A (Dedicated/Enterprise): full cache+quant+eval-alerts; Tier B (Host/SMB): batching + lightweight cache + opt-in quant.

liam: Risk callout: quantization impacts eval signal fidelity. We need an >80% concordance check before enabling quant for Tier A production.

maya: Good note. Let's add a gating metric: eval-concordance >= 80% on our customer-specific prompt sets for three successive runs. If fail -> metric triggers auto-rollback of quant rollout and opens incident.

jordan: Also need SDK telemetry hooks (token-level timings + backend variant) before we can meaningfully route by policy. Without it, we can't prioritize infra work correctly.

sam: Agree. Telemetry dependency blocks routing heuristics and cost-suggestions in Optimize. Suggest priority: 1) SDK telemetry + event schema, 2) batching runtime improvements, 3) caching prefix store, 4) quant pipeline + eval infra, 5) eval-triggered alert rules.

maya: Proposed acceptance gates for MVP (short list):
- SDK telemetry schema published + test harness
- Latency p95 improvement validated for batching on internal workload (>=15% vs baseline)
- Cache hit-rate > 20% on targeted interactive flows during smoke tests
- Quant concordance >=80% on per-customer eval sets
- Eval-triggered alerts configured for regressions (false positive rate < 10%)

liam: Quick config example for eval alert rule suggestion:
```
rule_name: prompt_set_concordance
window: 24h
threshold: 0.80
action: rollback-quant, notify-ops, open-ticket
```

maya: That looks good. Who owns the telemetry schema? @sam? If yes we can set a three-week ETA and mark it highest priority.

sam: I can own it but need help from eng-runtime (batching) for trace points. ETA 3w assuming we get 1 FTE from runtime for the sprint.

jordan: I'll coordinate with runtime and add the dependency to the sprint board. Also adding a short runbook for rollback steps (quant fallback -> model-variant switch -> notify customers).

deploy-bot: CI pipeline /optimize-toolkit/telemetry validated — all tests passing on branch feature/telemetry-schema.

maya: OK. Next steps: sam + jordan to finalize telemetry schema by end of week; liam to draft concordance test harness; I will write the priority matrix and share for sign-off. If no objections by EOD Friday we'll lock scope for the first dev sprint. :thumbsup:
